digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, ticket model, FILE_IMPACT event stream
propositions: Empty file_impact is ambiguous between author omission and genuinely no file impact, causing overly conservative attestation invalidation
Undeclared file_impact causes dependency_hashes to return empty set, triggering whole-HEAD freshness fallback and invalidating attestations on any commit
A single non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons the container's entire inherited drift scope to empty, collapsing siblings' careful file-path declarations
An explicit tri-state declaration (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason for the none state allows precise scoping and reviewable attestation validity
A ticket explicitly declaring no file impact should maintain valid attestation across unrelated commits, while undeclared tickets remain invalidated by any commit
The no-file-impact assertion must be part of the material fingerprint and subject to LLM-judged plan-review criterion to verify truthfulness of the claim
